name: Taikisha Ltd.
summary: Taikisha Ltd. engages in the environmental systems and painting systems businesses in Japan. The company operates through two segments: Environmental Systems Business and Painting Systems Business. The company is involved in the design, supervision and construction of building air conditioning equipment for general offices and industrial air conditioning equipment for production facilities in factories and research laboratories; and manufacture and sales of related equipment and materials. It also engages in the design, supervision, and construction of painting equipment related to the automobile and aviation industry, as well as related manufacturing and selling equipment and materials.
